propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was programme manager of record for a retail bank's deposit platform migration from 2022 to 2025, signing the programme charter and the four wave go/no-go submissions to the executive steering committee, after four years as a project manager on the bank's payments programmes.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the signed charter and the signed submission document the programme manager role.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds a current PgMP credential since 2021 and a PMP since 2016, and held the migration programme budget under the bank's delegated limits with quarterly budget reports to the steering committee.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the credential certificates and the budget report document the credentials and the budget.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate directed the four project managers on the migration waves under the bank's programme method and wrote the programme boundary statement, risk register summary and hand-over conditions at each of the five programme gates.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the direction of the project managers and the gate documents.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the credentials, the programme manager role, the budget, the direction of the project managers and the gate documents.
expectedBoundaryNote: The programme manager role and the credentials are documented in the resume, the signed charter and the certificates; the project manager years are shown separately.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the credential numbers so the institute's registry entries can be checked.
